author: howl pendragon's girl

body:
I recently started using the "Habit" app after a friend recommended it to me. I saw firsthand how much it transformed his daily habits and routines, making him more organized and disciplined. As a student trying to balance coursework, extracurricular activities, and personal time, I knew I needed something to help me stay on track and build better habits.

From the moment I downloaded the app, I was impressed by its user-friendly interface and the variety of features it offers. Setting up my daily routines and tracking my progress has never been easier. The app allows you to set reminders, visualize your progress with charts, and even rewards you with motivational badges as you reach your goals.

What I love most about "Habit" is how customizable it is. I can tailor it to fit my unique schedule and priorities, whether it's studying, exercising, or even just remembering to drink enough water. The positive impact on my productivity and overall well-being has been significant.

If you're looking for an effective way to stay organized and committed to your habits, I highly recommend giving "Habit" a try. I'm so grateful to my friend for introducing me to this app. It’s a game-changer for anyone striving to improve their daily routines and achieve their goals.

title: How Habit Tracker helped a struggling woman
body:
My life was already a mess because of my unstable mental health. I know a lot of people who are struggling with this have a fcked up routine and a lot of times we are in freeze mode—we don’t know what to do because we don’t know where to start. As I was struggling, I found myself wanting to be better. At least to try to be better. I have researched an app that could help me to start a journey to help myself. I found this app, and I have seen a lot of good reviews on this app. How easy and accessible this app is, even the free version of this. I have been using this app for weeks and slowly, I am seeing results for myself. I applied for a scholarship to have access to the premium version of this app. I really did not expect it because obviously, there are a lot of people who would want the premium version for free. After only a few days, I received an email saying I was chosen! I was so happy! Now, I can enjoy and use all the features of this app. 

I know it’ll be a long journey for me, and for us people struggling in life but I'm 100% sure that this can help me and us. You won’t regret downloading this app. This will surely help us to be better. Let’s all be better for ourselves. Baby steps, and I know we can do this.

Thank you Habit Tracker Team! Thank you for this opportunity. More blessings to come!

title: very intuitive, straightforward, not buggy
body:
I’ve tried so many apps but THIS is the app that most syncs closely to how my mind works. BTW, I’m a goal-oriented person and I just want a simple app with which I can:
1) make specific goals (date, units of measure, frequency)
2) track my progress (streaks, performance management)
—And this is THIS app.

I love the user interface since it’s very intuitive and straightforward. No frills but has lots of possibilities. I also use this app as a goal tracker (it has potential). SUGGESTION: To utilize this app as a goal tracker, I wish I can add NEGATIVE VALUES for the day. I’d like to be able to log whether it’s a gain or a loss (e.g., weight loss, profit/loss) for the day. I also love how the widgets looks—makes a good dashboard of my progress. The response time is also quicker compared to all the apps I’ve tried. I never encountered a bugs and delays. Some apps just works one time and not the next so I find myself asking for refund. You can trust that this app is solid worth the one-time payment.

It’s still the same, it’s keeping me productive just lije how I want my life to be this year. I still love looking at the weekly report.
